editorial.blurb: Mariela is a soul-stirring seafood destination in the historic Reliance Building where impeccable hospitality, stunning design, and inventive cuisine come together to create something truly memorable.
editorial.insiderTip: Go with a group and order family-style to maximize the experience—the Arroz Negro Paella feeds 4, and the $14 sides are shareable; ask your server like Donyae for guidance on navigating the tapas-style menu.

topDishes.note: Perfectly cooked, light yet satisfying, with sauce that ties the whole plate together
Feeds 4 easily, utterly splittable, flavor on every level
Bright, citrusy lemongrass heat that builds slowly—a completely different, better take on the dish
